prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle spasm. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Over the course of ten visits, care included physical therapy, manual therapy, home exercise instruction, and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. The duration of treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for a uncomplicated lumbar strain, and progress was gradual but steady. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of a lumbar soft tissue injury consistent with the reported incident. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing review of two similar charges recorded on the same date of service is currently in progress. At discharge, the patient had improved in range of motion and pain levels but still reported intermittent discomfort with prolonged sitting. Continued home exercise and follow-up as needed were recommended.
